text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm passing through the school
gates...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It's the head of the disciplinary
committee,
Bamboo Memory! I wonder if
she's doing rounds?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She almost looks... sinister. I bet she's a
real
stickler when it comes to school rule
violations
and stuff...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, greetings! You're one of the
school
trainers, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nope! Recently, there've been reports of
a
suspicious woman in a white coat and
mask
running around campus, so I'm on
the lookout!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No prob! Just doing my duty as a
member of the
disciplinary committee!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text: Urgent news, Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What is it?!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship started practicing a giant
swing
wrestling move in the central plaza
all of a
sudden...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That Golshi! She's always causing a
ruckus!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it'll be trouble if she makes herself
dizzy,
falls over, and hurts herself...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I shall stop her at once!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I shall stop her at once!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No worries! This is nothing, really!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, it's a good thing when people
start
causing trouble because it means
they're in good
spirits!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I just need to keep an eye out and make
sure they
don't do anything totally off
the charts. Rest
assured—I've got this.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, some trouble still catches me off
guard, but
it also adds some zest into my
life. Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory has a big smile on her
face as
she runs off.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! If I make a straight dash
toward the
plaza, I'll get there in no
time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If it's not too much trouble, could you
watch over
this area for me?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa, thanks! I owe you big time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to earn my keep as the

no-nonsense leader of the disciplinary
committee
and get things under control!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text: Bamboo! Wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory sprints off, leaving the
other
committee member frantically
chasing after her.
